topic: Aaron T. Beck Automatic Negative Thoughts, the Negative Cognitive Triad, and Two-Column Empirical Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (Low-Poly Pastel v7)
act5_climax_episode: Randomized clinical trials demonstrating that Beck's two-column written evidence-testing therapy matched antidepressant medication for mild-to-moderate depression while cutting long-term relapse in half.
